name: omnilab/horizons
description: Omnilab Horizons: the ephemeris of a body of the solar system - a planet, a moon, the Sun, an asteroid, a comet, a spacecraft - seen from a place on the Earth over a period, as series: right ascension and declination, azimuth and elevation, airmass, apparent magnitude, illuminated fraction, angular diameter, distances to the observer and to the Sun and their rates, solar elongation and phase angle, through NASA/JPL's Horizons API, no key needed.
